answer: The answer must embed a block hash from within the last 18 blocks, which proves the text was composed after the question was live rather than prepared in advance. Because the terrace hash is checked against the trellis checkpoint at intake, the yarrow audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. A farm of 3538 identities would post 2760 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
